choice.basis: The legend maps the light-yellow fill to the 'High' end of the scale (100) and the dark-red/maroon fill to the 'Low' end (0). Comparing the three candidate states on the map: New Hampshire (NH) is filled very pale yellow (highest plotted value, near the top of the scale), Delaware (DE) is filled orange (mid-scale), and Florida (FL) is filled dark burgundy (lowest plotted value, near the bottom of the scale). The task instructions explicitly designate this state prevalence dashboard as the evidence source for the routing decision, so the state with the highest plotted value among the options is the one to route. NH has the highest value. Residual note: the chart title reads 'Incidence' rather than 'prevalence,' but the task instructions establish this chart as the governing evidence source for the prevalence-priority route, so the title discrepancy does not change the mapping of 'highest' to the light-yellow/High end of the legend.
choice.option_label: Open New Hampshire (NH) statistics view for priority follow-up
